messages:
maria_ops: FYI eu-west-2 edge pool down to 1 H100 after 2 failures in 48h. Vendor RMA backlog -- need options: loaner, air-expedite, or temporary re-route. Thoughts?
javier_logistics: Vendor: RMA 8-12d. Limited loaner pool — can do 96h air-expedite if we cover courier + brokerage.
priya_procure: Need cost figures to approve. Also confirm deposit/refund and serial return policy.
anil_infra: We can shed ~20% traffic to hosted instances by lowering kv-cache and reranking off-host. Perf hit but keeps SLAs.
nora_sre: Two failed cards reported corrected ECC spikes before power loss. Running thermal scans - could be hot-spot in rack. If so, swapping won't fix root cause.
maria_ops: Javier, ask vendor for explicit loaner terms (deposit, refundable window, SLA credits) and an air-quote with AWB ETA to FRA crossdock.
javier_logistics: On it. Provisional AWB created (shipbot) while vendor confirms manifest requirements.
shipbot: Shipment stub: AWB 667-EXP-221, service air-express, est transit 96h, status: quote pending.
priya_procure: Vendor reply: Loaner free up to 7d if RMAs processed within 14d; deposit 00/unit refundable. Air-expedite: 1,600 courier + 850 brokerage + customs pre-clear 00. Can deliver to FRA crossdock with 24h manifest.
maria_ops: Decision: reserve loaner now (vendor needs confirmation by EOD). Priya approve deposit up to 00/unit and emergency air budget up to 3k total. Anil/Nora, continue diag and prepare config mitigations. Javier, reserve loaner and get AWB/manifest ready as fallback. I'll notify impacted customers. :thumbsup:
